model.shop_analytics.stg_orders.name: stg_orders
model.shop_analytics.stg_orders.compiled_code: select cast(order_id as bigint) as order_id, cast(customer_id as bigint) as customer_id, cast(order_total as decimal(18, 2)) as order_total, cast(created_at as date) as created_at from raw.orders

model.shop_analytics.orders.name: orders
model.shop_analytics.orders.compiled_code: select o.order_id, cast(o.customer_id as varchar) as customer_id, o.order_total, o.created_at from analytics.stg_orders as o cross join raw.customer_segments as segments

model.shop_analytics.daily_revenue.name: daily_revenue
model.shop_analytics.daily_revenue.compiled_code: select created_at as order_date, sum(order_total) as revenue from analytics.orders group by created_at
